name: Merge PDFs
tagline: Put several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.
description: Combine PDF files into one, free and right in your browser. Put them in any order. Nothing is uploaded, no sign-up, no watermark.

specs.Limits: As many files as your device's memory allows
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. The PDFs are read and combined inside this browser tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: Does it keep links and bookmarks?
faq.a: Page content, links on the page and form fields are kept. The combined file doesn't carry over each file's bookmarks outline yet.
Not yet. Remove the password in your PDF reader first, then merge.
